title: BMW reveals US 3 series pricing: The EV carries a hefty premium
gist: BMW opened US orders for the Neue Klasse 3 Series, with the electric i3 50 xDrive priced at $61,500 and expected range of 446-468 miles, versus gas 330 models from $49,900 and an M350 at $65,900; first cars arrive Q1 2027.

insights.claim: BMW's new 3 Series, built on the all-new Neue Klasse platform, offers a fully electric version for the first time using BMW's sixth-generation electric powertrain from the iX3.
insights.speaker: Jonathan M. Gitlin
insights.so_what: Electrifying its core volume sedan is a major test of BMW's EV transition.
insights.locator: BMW has opened the US order books

insights.claim: The 2027 BMW i3 50 xDrive has 463 hp and 467 lb-ft and BMW expects 446 to 468 miles of range, aided by a cylindrical-cell, cell-to-body battery pack that maximizes energy density.
insights.speaker: Jonathan M. Gitlin
insights.so_what: Near-500-mile range removes a key EV purchase objection in the premium sedan segment.
insights.locator: At launch, the only electric version

insights.claim: BMW plans an i3 M60 xDrive later next year followed by the first fully electric M3 with four motors, one per wheel.
insights.speaker: Jonathan M. Gitlin
insights.so_what: A high-performance EV lineup extends BMW's EV pricing ladder upward.

themes.theme: Pricing gap between EV and gas

insights.claim: The 2027 i3 50 xDrive starts at $61,500, slightly below the 2026 i4 xDrive40 at $62,300, which is less powerful and has about 60% of the i3's range.
insights.speaker: Jonathan M. Gitlin
insights.so_what: BMW is delivering much more EV for similar money, implying improved battery cost or margin trade-offs.
insights.quote: we can tell you the price of the 2027 i3 50 xDrive: $61,500
insights.locator: Pricing for those future electric variants

insights.claim: BMW says the first Neue Klasse 3 Series cars will arrive in the US in Q1 2027.
insights.speaker: Jonathan M. Gitlin
insights.so_what: Revenue contribution from the new 3 Series starts in 2027.
insights.quote: BMW says that the first cars will arrive in Q1 2027.

insights.claim: The gas-powered 2027 BMW 330 starts at $49,900, a $1,900 increase over the outgoing model, with the 330 xDrive at $51,900, leaving the EV at a roughly $11,600 premium over the base gas car.
insights.speaker: Jonathan M. Gitlin
insights.so_what: A large EV premium over the gas equivalent may slow EV mix in the US.
insights.quote: That’s the 2027 330, which starts at $49,900, a $1,900 premium over the outgoing 2026 model
insights.locator: I’m not ready for a plug

insights.claim: The 2027 M350 xDrive, the first inline-six model built at BMW's Dingolfing plant, makes 437 hp and carries the highest launch price at $65,900.
insights.speaker: Jonathan M. Gitlin
insights.so_what: Combustion performance variants remain the top-priced trims at launch.
